month_block_bootstrap.unit: calendar month, preserving within-month realized trade order

matched_random.pool: all causally feature-ready M15 decision rows in the same development month with exact M1 entry
matched_random.execution: same fixed spread, stop, target, horizon and one-position accounting
matched_random.sampling: without replacement within month; deterministic independent iteration seeds

pseudo_state.construction: cyclically shift each candidate's monthly boolean event mask by a non-zero random offset within that month, preserving monthly count and local clustering/spacing

parameter_neighborhood.neighbors: one adjacent grid step in stop ATR, target R, or horizon, changing one dimension at a time

entry_delay_diagnostics.purpose: fragility diagnostic only; not eligible for rescue or selection

finalist_selection.if_fewer_pass: freeze fewer finalists; do not relax controls

prohibitions: do not change the nine development definitions
do not delete or add directions after control results
do not alter stop, target, horizon, month, session or threshold to rescue
do not inspect 2026 final-test outcomes before finalist registry freeze
